pred_texts: Instruct: Get a large pan and put it on the stove.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Switch on the stove and add 2 tablespoons of oil.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now, get a chopping board, knife and an onion.
Instruct: Dice one full onion.
Instruct: Now, you need to add the chopped onion to the pan.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now, grab 2 tomatoes and dice them into small cubes.
Feedback: You are cutting mushrooms instead of tomatoes as instructed. Please switch to using tomatoes for this step.
Instruct: Add the two diced tomatoes to the pan.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Gently stir the ingredients in the pan at low heat.
Instruct: Open your packet of tofu and dice it up in small cubes.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Add the tofu to the same pan.
Instruct: Add salt to the pan according to your taste.
Instruct: Now, add pepper to the pan according to your taste.
Instruct: Now, mix all the ingredients together.
Instruct: Cover the pan with a lid and your tofu should be ready in about 10 minutes.
Success: Step complete.
